decisions.reason: Naming the minted memoir does not change the mint price, revenue shares, fee treatment, or prize-pool allocation.
The existing same-message FAQ update identifies only the client's memoir generically, but the supplied FAQ necessarily names the launched work as "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal."

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
tweak this where you have to , but here is the FAQ section -

What is Project Rebuild?
Project Rebuild is the live proof-of-concept for FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) — the first system that lets indie creators sell unlimited NFT ebooks and pay readers real commissions + prizes to spread them.
It's launching with my raw memoir novella, "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal," on Base.
And it's my public mission to rebuild my family's life after losing millions to a seed-phrase wipeout.
If FAMM proves itself, Project Rebuild evolves into BooksOnChain — a community-owned public good platform for every creator.

How do buyers earn money?
1\. $5 instant commission every time someone mints with your referral code
2\. Small & Big Block prize tickets every time someone mints with your code
3\. \*\*\*If FAMM is proven successful, and with zero guarantee of success or value\*\*\*
Future BooksOnChain governance token allocation will be to buyers, affiliates, and tippers of "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal".

How do referrals work?
Every NFT’s mint number IS its permanent referral code.
Examples that both work perfectly:
→ Share your full link
→ Or just say “use referral 423”
When someone mints using your code → you instantly get $5 + Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks.
→ If no referral code is used on mint → commission and tickets are sent to a random existing NFT holder.

Where do I find my referral code?
It’s your mint number. You’ll see it:
\- On your NFT
\- In your NFT metadata
\- On your Dashboard after minting
\- In your confirmation email (optional)

What are Small Block and Big Block prizes?
Small Block: 5 × $500 drawn every ~500 sales (mint + secondary)
Big Block: 5 × $10,000 drawn every ~50,000 sales (mint + secondary)
Pools funded from every sale forever.

How are winners selected?
Chainlink VRF — fully on-chain, provably fair, verifiable on Basescan.

What are Small & Big Block prize tickets?
Entries for the current Small & Big Block prize draws.
Earn them by getting people to mint with your code (1 Small + 1 Big per successful referral).
More tickets → more chances to win.
Once the block is drawn, those tickets expire and new referrals count toward the next blocks.

How do I claim my rewards?
\- $5 commissions → sent automatically to your wallet
\- Prize wins → announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click here on <http://projectrebuild.xyz>

What are badges?
On-chain badges added to your NFT for hitting referral milestones (2, 10, 50, 100+).
Currently cosmetic + leaderboard flex.
In future these may be used to unlock any number of things, token-gated chats, discounts, etc.

Can I mint with fiat (credit card)?
Yes — Transak supports cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay.

Do I need a wallet to participate?
No, not for minting with fiat.
But yes if you want to receive commissions, hold prize tickets, or sell/trade the NFT later.

What blockchain is this on?
Base (Ethereum L2) — fast, cheap, secure.

Are there any hidden fees?
No. Mint = exactly $15. Secondary sales carry a visible $10 flat royalty.

What happens if I sell my NFT?
The buyer gets the book, mint number (now their referral code), any badges earned, and any active prize tickets (expired ones stay expired).

How do I share my referral link/code?
Dashboard → copy full link or just copy your mint number and tell people “use referral 423”.

Is this a scam or pyramid scheme?
No. Single-level only. Full source verified on Basescan. I earn $4 on every sale forever (minus any fiat fees) — same cut on mints and secondary sales. The rest feeds commissions and prize pools.

How do I contact support?
No Discord yet (will launch once we have real traction).
For now:
DM @ProjectRebuild on X
or
email will@projectrebuild.xyz

Still have questions? DM @ProjectRebuild on X or email will@projectrebuild.xyz — happy to help.

decisions.reason: The minted asset's title does not alter the mint-number referral-code basis, permanence, or display locations.
The asset title does not change Transak, the fiat conversion flow, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements.
The asset title is incidental to the no-referral trigger and random commission-and-ticket recipient rules.
The source does not require the confirmation email to include the asset title and does not change its optional availability or referral-code content.
Naming the minted work does not change which sale types fund prize pools or how long funding continues.
The asset title does not affect referral badge conditions or milestone thresholds.
The minted asset's name has no effect on the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
Although the asset is an NFT ebook, the supplied metadata requirement tracks ticket counters and badges; the source does not require adding the book title to that metadata state.
The asset title does not change manual prize claiming, the Winners page, or the one-click claim interaction.
The asset title does not affect ticket eligibility, weighting, Chainlink VRF, or on-chain winner verification.
